headline: Google ships Gemini 4 Hydrogen and brings it to Search
dek: The fast agent model is already in Google Search, per Google DeepMind.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Hydrogen hits Search
body: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen and already put it in Google Search worldwide, per Google DeepMind and Google AI.
It was built for fast execution in agent workflows (Google DeepMind).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Orchestrator
body: The feature switches between Hydrogen and Carbon and used 24% less quota, per Google DeepMind.
Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash (Google DeepMind).

items.t: It is on the free Gemini app plan (SiliconANGLE).
Gemini API and Google AI Studio (Google DeepMind).
In Antigravity, Pro and Ultra only (SiliconANGLE).

caption.hook: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen and already put it in Google Search worldwide.
body: Per Google DeepMind and SiliconANGLE, Hydrogen was built for fast execution in agent workflows. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index it scored 51 points, against 50 for Argon, and reaches 54 on the new xhigh level. It costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 for output.

Antigravity's Orchestrator switches between Hydrogen and Carbon and used 24% less quota in tests, per Google DeepMind. It also says Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash. SiliconANGLE reports the model is on the free Gemini app plan and in the API.
